list.heading: Macros and canned responses
list.caption: Shared ones for your departments, and your own.
list.footer: {{shown}} of {{total}} · Personal items are visible to their owner only.

empty.heading: No macros yet
empty.body: Create a canned response for a reply you write often, or a macro that also sets status, tags and the assignee.

editor.name: Name
editor.scopeNote: Shared items are edited by Admins and by Team Leaders of the department. Every agent in it can use them. Anyone can keep personal ones.

reply.heading: Reply
reply.caption: The contact's language picks the variant; an empty Arabic variant falls back to English.
reply.captionMacro: Optional for a macro. The contact's language picks the variant; an empty Arabic variant falls back to English.

placeholders.hint: Inserted at the cursor. Sample values shown.

problems.englishRequired: A canned response needs its English text.
problems.nothingToDo: A macro needs a reply, an action, or both.
problems.actionIncomplete: Choose a value for every action, or remove it.
problems.arabicWithoutEnglish: English is the default variant; write it before the Arabic one.

editor.cannedNote: A canned response has the same editor without Actions.

nothing.heading: Nothing selected
nothing.body: Choose a macro or canned response to edit it, or create a new one.

actions.caption: Staged when the macro is applied and run in this order when the reply is sent; at once if there is no reply.

confirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirm.body: Agents can no longer apply it. Replies already sent with it stay as they are.

picker.label: Insert a macro or canned response
picker.scopeNote: Only items shared with {{department}}, shared with all departments, or your own.
picker.fellBack: The Arabic variant is empty, so English is used
picker.highlightNote: Highlighted text came from placeholders. It is inserted as plain text you can edit.
picker.noReply: This macro has no reply. Its actions run as soon as you apply it.
